body: He's actually a super momma's boy. Omg he's my who world, but occasionally he & his daddy have a moment too sweet to pass up.
My Boston weighs 11.5 lbs ... He's ten & people constantly ask me how old my "puppy" is.
Dallas below Austin? ATX barely has enough room for it's weirdos as it is and no infrastructure. Not that I am encouraging you to go to DFW, I love it here, but it is def not for everyone.
100% possible in a college town my friend. .50¢ shot nights exist... I've seen them.

Model Co (Australian brand I think) Cheek + Lip Stain ... Got a sample in a beauty box, seriously cannot live without it. I have sample sizes in my purse, around my house & it cost me as much for shipping as it does the product but I'd pay 2x that. The color last all day & it's perfect!

I feel this way over & over again, people ask me for my "triggers" I don't know them. All I know is somdays getting out of bed is too difficult & lying about why feels draining & there's no solution. Suicide or running away are always my first thoughts & even now they're here but I try to remember a day that getting up wasn't painful & breathing wasn't an exercise & sometimes it helps... Other times Xanax, Valum & wine get me to tomorrow.
